title: Pune realtor Ketan Agarwal murder: Police custody of accused fiancee Siya Goyal extended till July 3
description: A magistrate court near Pune today extended the police custody of Siya Goyal and her alleged boyfriend Chetan Chaudhary till July 3 in connection with the murder of Goyal's fiancee and Pune based realtor Ketan Agarwal.The judicial magistrate at Wadgaon Mawal near Pune passed the order on June 29 after the local police produced Goyal and Chaudhary seeking extension of their custody. The prosecution cited 18 grounds in support of its plea seeking extension of custody. Advocates Vipul Dushing,
